description: We're looking for somebody who can complete their task fast and efficiently with a fairly big amount of knowledge of science, especially of space, someone who is reliable and can communicate with others clearly.
summary:
While exploring space rovers, we realized how difficult it was to remember all the scientific information. Many students, both our age and older, lack motivation to learn science as it often involves reading endless materials. We wanted to change that, introducing rovers and the fascinating science behind them in a way that school-age enthusiasts could enjoy.

This inspired us to create Space Memory Lab, a physical model and a website. 
The former features two zones: orange for Mars and blue for the Moon. Each zone contains four stations, providing concise summaries instead of lengthy paragraphs.
The latter, accessed through a QR code, has various features to enjoy. It includes simulations, memory games, and rover quizzes. A leaderboard is added to encourage healthy competition and collaborative learning.

Although our project may not be perfect, we believe that from a 6th-grader’s perspective, Space Memory Lab offers a more exciting alternative to traditional science learning.
details: The website has several games to help students remember all the information while still enjoying the process. We added a tutorial so students could understand how to use the website. Aside from getting more students to take up science, our goal is also to give many students, both our age and older, the motivation to learn science, introducing rovers and the fascinating science behind them in a way that school-age enthusiasts could enjoy. We used Claude AI and Netlify to bring the website to life, instead of staying on our paper pages. The simulation in our project is definitely one of the best features, you can see how long it takes the rovers to get from Earth to The Moon or Mars. And you can even craft your own landing, see the outcome and learn from it. Aside from the main 5 factors that we will be judged on, we also considered if our target audience would really enjoy using this or not.
